translations.u197: In transactions in which it is expressly agreed that, after the conclusion of the Binding Agreement, the Vehicle shall temporarily remain in use by the Seller, Fleequid may require the Buyer to pay in advance an amount equal to 30% of the Total Amount Due (the “Advance Payment”). The arrangement governed by this article is referred to, for descriptive and commercial purposes only, as a “Deferred Sale”. The Deferred Sale does not constitute a separate Sales Model and remains subject in its entirety to the Sales Model applicable to the specific transaction and, in the context of the Commission Sale, to the relevant method of performance. The Deferred Sale may be agreed exclusively in the Commission Sale performed by means of Resale and in Dealer Sales and does not apply where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary; in Commission Sale transactions to which this article applies, Fleequid therefore performs the transaction by means of Resale. The fact that the Vehicle temporarily remains in use by the Seller, together with the Special Sale Terms and Conditions applicable to the transaction, must be made known to the Bidder before the Bid is placed, in accordance with Arts. 3.2 and 4.5. Where requested, the Advance Payment must be paid within the ordinary Payment Period referred to in Art. 11.5, running from the date on which the Proforma is made available, unless the Special Sale Terms and Conditions expressly provide for a different period pursuant to Art. 11.6, letter b). These rules apply exclusively to such arrangement and constitute a derogation from the ordinary rules on the Payment Period within the limits provided for in this article and in the applicable Special Sale Terms and Conditions.
translations.u198: The Advance Payment is made on account of the price and is applied to the Total Amount Due where the transaction is duly completed. The Advance Payment constitutes neither a confirmatory deposit nor a withdrawal deposit, and Arts. 1385 and 1386 of the Italian Civil Code do not apply.
translations.u199: The balance of the Total Amount Due, less the Advance Payment already paid, must be paid by the different due date established for the specific transaction and made known to the Buyer in the Special Sale Terms and Conditions. Until the balance has been paid in full, the Vehicle remains in Optioned Status and the Seller remains bound by the sale and by the obligations provided for in Arts. 8.8, 8.12 and 11.3, subject to the derogations referred to in Art. 13.4. Payment of the Advance Payment does not, in itself, result in the commencement of the performance phase of the sale or, in the case of Auctions, in the Final Award, which follow only from full performance of the payment obligation in accordance with Art. 12.2.
translations.u200: The Seller may continue to use the Vehicle only within the limits and on the conditions agreed for the specific transaction, in derogation from the general obligation to keep it unused and available for sale provided for in Art. 8.12. During that period the Seller is, in particular, required to: a) keep the Vehicle available for subsequent delivery; b) refrain from selling it, promising it to third parties, creating Encumbrances over it or otherwise making it unavailable; c) keep the Vehicle in its custody with due care, maintain it in efficient working order and preserve, in so far as compatible with the authorised use, its condition and characteristics as resulting from the Technical Specifications; d) not exceed any mileage limit agreed; e) notify Fleequid without delay of any accident, failure, deterioration, damage or other event capable of affecting the condition, value, availability or marketability of the Vehicle; f) comply with the date agreed for the cessation of use and for making the Vehicle available or releasing it. The Special Sale Terms and Conditions applicable to the specific transaction shall indicate at least: the date on which the Vehicle is to be released or made available; the maximum additional mileage permitted; the due date for payment of the balance; the consequences of exceeding the mileage limit, of deterioration and of delay in making the Vehicle available or releasing it. The financial consequences arising from exceeding the limits on use, mileage or duration or from the other conditions laid down for the temporary use of the Vehicle by the Seller, including any penalties, indemnities, adjustments or tolerances, are determined in the Special Sale Terms and Conditions applicable to the specific transaction.
translations.u201: Failure to pay the Advance Payment within the relevant period, or failure to pay the balance in full by the due date established for the specific transaction, constitutes delay on the part of the Buyer. From the first day following the respective due date, the provisions of Art. 12.6 shall apply, in so far as compatible, including the penalty of €150.00 (EUR one hundred and fifty/00) for each day of delay and for each Vehicle concerned, up to the maximum aggregate amount provided for in Art. 12.6, letter a), which operates as a single cap for each Vehicle and for the same transaction with reference both to delay in paying the Advance Payment and to delay in paying the balance, as well as the interest and the further amounts provided for therein. In the event of failure to pay the Advance Payment, the time limits and rights provided for in Art. 12.7 shall apply. In the event of failure to pay the balance, in place of the maximum time limit provided for in Art. 12.7, Fleequid retains the right to receive late payment for the 4 (four) days following the due date established for payment of the balance, without a new period of 7 (seven) days running from that due date. Once that period has expired without payment in full, Fleequid may, at its discretion, nevertheless accept late payment or proceed with the Cancellation of the Sale in accordance with Art. 12.7, with the effects referred to in Arts. 12.8 and 12.9.
translations.u202: Where Fleequid proceeds with the Cancellation of the Sale on account of delay in paying, or failure to pay, the Advance Payment or the balance, in each case attributable to the Buyer pursuant to Art. 13.5, the Advance Payment actually paid can no longer be applied to the price and is definitively converted into a further, independent penalty, which is retained by Fleequid. The conversion does not operate where the Cancellation of the Sale follows breaches by the Buyer other than those governed by Art. 13.5, such as, by way of example, failure to collect the Vehicle after payment in full. The said penalty may be cumulated, within the limits permitted by law, with the daily penalty accrued pursuant to Art. 13.5, with the Commissions payable by the Buyer and with the further penalties, Fees and amounts due pursuant to Art. 12.9, it being understood that this penalty is counted for the purposes of reaching the financial floor provided for in Art. 12.9, which operates exclusively for any difference necessary to reach the relevant threshold. Where the Advance Payment has not been paid or has been paid only in part, the conversion into a penalty operates exclusively up to the amount actually paid, without prejudice to all further amounts owed by the Buyer as a result of the breach and of the Cancellation of the Sale. Fleequid's right to compensation for any further damage, solely for the part in excess, remains unaffected.
translations.u203: Where, for reasons attributable to the Seller, the transaction cannot be completed or the Vehicle cannot be transferred or delivered as agreed, Fleequid may proceed with the Cancellation of the Sale, without prejudice to any further remedy provided for in these General Terms and Conditions. In such case the Advance Payment actually paid is returned in full to the Buyer in accordance with Art. 15, and the consequences provided for in the event of breach by the Buyer shall not apply to the Buyer. Cancellation of the Sale for reasons attributable to the Seller neither prejudices nor absorbs the consequences of the Seller's breach: the Seller shall be subject, in so far as compatible, to the same penalties, Fees, obligations to pay compensation and further consequences provided for in these General Terms and Conditions for breach by the Seller in transactions in which the Vehicle does not temporarily remain in use by the Seller, including those provided for in Arts. 8.11, 16.9 and 17.8 in the event of failure to transfer ownership, failure to deliver or unavailability of the Vehicle, without prejudice to any provisions of the Special Sale Terms and Conditions for the specific transaction. Any consequences provided for in the Special Sale Terms and Conditions in relation to exceeding the permitted mileage, deterioration of the Vehicle, delay in making it available or releasing it and the other obligations specific to this arrangement are in addition, where expressly provided and within the limits permitted by law, to the remedies applicable pursuant to the preceding sentence. Where the Seller significantly affects the value, characteristics or availability of the Vehicle, Fleequid may in any event proceed with the Cancellation of the Sale, return to the Buyer the amounts due to the Buyer pursuant to Art. 15 and retain in full the remedies available to it against the Seller.
translations.u204: Save as expressly derogated from by this article or by the Special Sale Terms and Conditions applicable to the specific transaction, all the provisions of these General Terms and Conditions relating to the applicable Sales Model and to the chosen method of performance remain applicable in full, including those concerning invoicing, the time limits for the issue, transmission, correction or reissue of the relevant documents, any penalties connected with delay, payment of the sums due to the Seller, transfer of ownership, the necessary documentation, and delivery and collection of the Vehicle. The fact that the Vehicle temporarily remains in use by the Seller and the particular structure of payment provided for in this article do not, in themselves, entail any derogation from the other obligations of the Seller or of the Buyer, unless the derogation results expressly from the applicable Special Sale Terms and Conditions.
translations.u205: Without prejudice to Art. 8.13, for the entire period during which the Vehicle temporarily remains in use by, or otherwise at the disposal of, the Seller pursuant to this article, all risks, liabilities and costs connected with the custody, use, circulation, preservation and availability of the Vehicle remain with the Seller, save for whatever is mandatorily attributable to Fleequid or to the Buyer. The Seller therefore undertakes to indemnify and hold harmless Fleequid and the Buyer, as well as the companies of the Fleequid group and their respective directors, employees, collaborators and agents, against any claim, demand, action, sanction, cost, expense, damage or liability arising, directly or indirectly, from the custody, use, circulation, preservation or availability of the Vehicle during that period, including those resulting from accidents, damage to persons or property, administrative or road traffic offences, absent or inadequate insurance cover, loss, theft, deterioration of or damage to the Vehicle, its unavailability, alteration of its condition or characteristics, exceeding of any limits on use or mileage agreed, as well as from claims made by third parties as a result of acts attributable to the Seller. This indemnity is in addition to that provided for in Art. 8.13 and neither excludes nor limits any mandatory obligations incumbent on Fleequid towards the Buyer by reason of the applicable Sales Model; in such cases Fleequid's right of recourse against the Seller for everything attributable to the Seller remains unaffected. The further rights of recourse, reimbursement and compensation available to Fleequid and to the Buyer under these General Terms and Conditions and under the law likewise remain unaffected, it being understood that this indemnity does not extend to consequences directly attributable to the wilful misconduct or gross negligence of the person seeking to rely on it.
translations.u207: The Cancellation of the Sale is the contractual mechanism by which Fleequid, in the cases provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, in the applicable Specific Terms and Conditions or in the applicable Special Sale Terms and Conditions, determines that the transaction shall not be performed or shall cease to be performed, in whole or in respect of one or more Vehicles only. The Cancellation of the Sale does not necessarily coincide with annulment of the contract on grounds of invalidity or with termination for breach: the actual legal basis depends on the individual circumstances giving rise to it. Where the Cancellation follows a breach covered by an express termination clause pursuant to these General Terms and Conditions, it operates as termination of the Contract pursuant to Art. 1456 of the Italian Civil Code and produces the effects thereof. In all other cases the Cancellation produces the effects provided for in the provision that provides for it and, in so far as not otherwise regulated, those provided for in this article and in Art. 15.
translations.u208: The conditions for and the grounds of the Cancellation of the Sale are governed by the provisions regulating the relevant circumstances and, in particular: by Art. 9.7, in the event of manifest clerical error; by Art. 12.7 in the event of delay in payment or failure to pay attributable to the Buyer; by Art. 13.7, for reasons attributable to the Seller, in transactions with the Vehicle temporarily in use by the Seller; by Arts. 16.7 and 16.9 in the event of failure by the Buyer to collect the Vehicle and of failure to deliver attributable to the Seller; by Art. 16.14 in the event that the Buyer does not meet the requirements; by Arts. 17.6, 17.8, 17.14 and 18.7 in the cases provided for therein; by Art. 20.8 as the outcome of the handling of a complaint; by Art. 4.9 in the event that the transaction subsequently becomes incompatible with the applicable legislation; as well as by Art. 14.4 below in the event of reduction of the subject matter of the sale. The further cases provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, in the Specific Terms and Conditions or in the Special Sale Terms and Conditions applicable to the specific transaction remain unaffected, and the provisions of this article may not be interpreted as limiting the rights conferred on Fleequid.
translations.u209: The Cancellation of the Sale is ordered by means of a unilateral declaration by Fleequid, notified in writing to the persons concerned in the manner provided for in Art. 24, and takes effect from the time of the notification, unless the provision applicable to the specific circumstances provides otherwise. Until that time the transaction is not automatically dissolved and the obligations of the Parties remain in force. The exercise of the right of Cancellation does not require a judicial determination of the relevant conditions and does not prejudice the further remedies available to Fleequid.
translations.u210: The transaction and the relevant Contract may relate to one or more Vehicles, including with partial transfer thereof. Where the transaction concerns more than one Vehicle, until the transfer and collection of the Vehicles concerned have been completed Fleequid reserves the right, at its discretion and for operational, technical or administrative reasons or for reasons otherwise connected with the proper performance of the transaction, to: a) cancel the sale in its entirety; b) cancel the sale in respect of one or more Vehicles only; or c) reduce the number of Vehicles forming the subject matter of the sale. This right constitutes an essential element of the functioning of the Marketplace and of the organisation of the transactions managed by Fleequid and may be exercised irrespective of whether the relevant causes are attributable to the Seller, to the Buyer, to third parties or, within the limits permitted by law, to Fleequid itself. It may be exercised, by way of example, in the event of supervening unavailability, loss, destruction of or damage to one or more Vehicles, technical, logistical, administrative or regulatory impediments, operational requirements relating to the management of the Vehicle, failure to collect within the time limits provided for, as well as in the event of breach of these General Terms and Conditions by the Seller or by the Buyer.
translations.u211: The reduction of the subject matter of the sale produces the effects of a partial termination of the Contract in respect of the Vehicles concerned only. The Contract remains valid and effective for the Vehicles not subject to cancellation and the Total Amount Due is redetermined accordingly. Where separate prices or values have been identified for the individual Vehicles for the purposes of the specific transaction, the redetermination is carried out by excluding the amounts referable to the Vehicles subject to cancellation. Where, on the other hand, a single overall price has been established without indication of the price referable to each Vehicle, the price is redetermined in proportion to the number of Vehicles for which the sale remains effective, unless the Special Sale Terms and Conditions or the agreements applicable to the specific transaction provide for a different allocation criterion. The Commissions, the Fees and the further amounts linked to the Vehicles for which the sale remains effective are redetermined accordingly, on the basis of the same criteria and in so far as applicable. In the Commission Sale the reduction entails the corresponding redetermination of the amounts due to the Seller with reference only to the Vehicles actually transferred, applying, in the absence of a separate valuation of the individual Vehicles, the same proportional criterion. In Dealer Sales with a purchase linked to the sale to a specific Buyer, the reduction entails, to the extent that the effects of the purchase pursuant to Arts. 8.8 and 18.2 have not yet been produced, the corresponding reduction of the Vehicles that Fleequid is required to purchase from the Seller and of the relevant Purchase Price, applying the criteria indicated above. The reduction of the subsequent sale to the Buyer does not, however, affect the Purchase Price or the other effects of a purchase for stock already concluded and effective between the Seller and Fleequid, unless otherwise agreed between the relevant Parties. In transactions relating to more than one Vehicle, the criteria provided for in this paragraph also apply to the determination of the bases of calculation of the penalties provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, including the Commissions, actual or notional, taken as a parameter: the basis consists of the value individually attributed to the individual Vehicle, where available, or, failing that, of the share of the overall value referable to it according to the proportional criterion indicated above, and the penalty is calculated exclusively with reference to the Vehicles affected by the breach or by the Cancellation.
translations.u212: The Buyer and the Seller expressly acknowledge and accept Fleequid's right to proceed with the Cancellation of the Sale and with the reduction of its subject matter in the cases provided for in this article and may not object to the continuation of the transaction in respect of the Vehicles for which the sale remains effective. Save as mandatorily provided for by law and save in cases of wilful misconduct or gross negligence on the part of Fleequid, the Buyer and the Seller are not entitled to any indemnity or compensation from Fleequid by reason of the mere fact of the Cancellation, of the partial cancellation or of the reduction of the subject matter of the sale, the only obligation remaining, to the extent of their respective entitlements, being the restitution of any sums paid with reference to the Vehicles subject to cancellation, in accordance with Art. 15. The further consequences provided for in these General Terms and Conditions remain unaffected where the Cancellation or the reduction is the consequence of a breach attributable to the Seller or to the Buyer.
translations.u213: In the Commission Sale the Commissions due to Fleequid remain payable with reference to the Vehicles for which the sale remains effective and is successfully completed pursuant to Art. 12.4. With reference to the Vehicles subject to Cancellation or reduction, the Commissions do not accrue, unless they have already validly accrued before the Cancellation in accordance with Art. 12.4. Where the Cancellation is the consequence of a breach attributable to the Buyer, the Commissions payable by the Buyer remain due in any event and the penalties, the Fees and the further amounts provided for in Arts. 12.8 and 12.9 shall apply. Where the Cancellation is the consequence of a breach attributable to the Seller, the Commissions payable by the Seller that have not yet accrued do not become due as consideration for the transaction, without prejudice to the penalties and the further amounts provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, even where determined by taking the Commissions that would have been due as a notional parameter of calculation, and to Fleequid's right to compensation for any further damage. Where the Cancellation is not attributable to the Buyer, the Commissions payable by the Buyer do not remain definitively due and, if already paid, are returned pursuant to Art. 15, unless otherwise expressly provided by a special provision of these General Terms and Conditions. In Dealer Sales the Commissions specific to the Commission Sale do not apply, without prejudice to the penalties, the Fees and any further amounts due.
translations.u214: The common restitutionary and financial effects of the Cancellation of the Sale and of the reduction of its subject matter are governed by Art. 15. Any special effects provided for in respect of individual circumstances remain governed by the relevant provisions and prevail, as regards the matters specifically regulated by them, over the general rules.
translations.u216: The obligation to return the sums paid by the Buyer arises: a) in the event of Cancellation of the Sale or of reduction of its subject matter pursuant to Art. 14, for the sums referable to the Vehicles for which the sale is not performed; b) in the event of Cancellation of the Sale ordered in the context of the handling of a complaint pursuant to Art. 20.8, within the limits provided for therein; c) in the event that the transaction is not completed for reasons attributable to the Seller, with reference to the Advance Payment and to any further sums paid by the Buyer that must be returned to the Buyer pursuant to Art. 13.7 and the other applicable provisions; d) in the event of Cancellation of the Sale for breach by the Buyer, limited to any excess of the sums already paid by the Buyer over the amounts that Fleequid or the other persons entitled may lawfully retain or apply pursuant to Art. 12.9; e) in the further cases in which these General Terms and Conditions, the Specific Terms and Conditions or the Special Sale Terms and Conditions provide for the return, in whole or in part, of sums paid by the Buyer. The separate rules on the Security Deposit provided for in Art. 6.3 and those on the Advance Payment provided for in Art. 13 remain unaffected.
translations.u217: The sums due pursuant to this article are returned within 15 (fifteen) days from the occurrence of the relevant condition or, if later, from the final determination of the sums to be returned, without payment of interest, save in the case of delay in the return beyond the said time limit. Where, for the purposes of determining the amount to be returned, it is necessary first to quantify or apply Commissions, penalties, interest, Fees, expenses or further sums due, the time limit runs from the time at which such determination has been completed.
translations.u218: The person required to return the sums paid by the Buyer is identified according to the person who actually received them and the applicable Sales Model. In the Commission Sale performed by means of Resale and in Dealer Sales, Fleequid returns the sums actually received by it from the Buyer, within the limits of what is due pursuant to these General Terms and Conditions. Where Fleequid has acted as a Pure Intermediary, the Seller is required to return the price of the Vehicle and the further sums directly received by it, while Fleequid returns the Commissions, the Fees and the further amounts directly received by it, each within the limits of the sums actually received and which must be returned. The different provisions laid down on the handling of complaints remain unaffected, as does Fleequid's right, where it advances to the Buyer sums the return of which is attributable to the Seller, to recover them in full from the Seller, together with any costs and the further amounts due.
translations.u219: Where payment has been made, in whole or in part, by a Financier, the sums to be returned are paid to the Financier within the limits of the amount actually paid by it, save as otherwise provided for in the applicable Specific Terms and Conditions or in joint written instructions from the Buyer and the Financier. Where part of the sums has been paid directly by the Buyer, the relevant return is made to the Buyer, according to the respective origin of the payments. It is understood that, where under the Specific Terms and Conditions the Financier has directly assumed the status of Buyer, the rights to restitution belong to the Financier.
translations.u220: In cases where the return of the sums entails, under the applicable tax legislation, the need to issue credit notes, reversal or correction documents or other tax documents, each person that issued the relevant invoice or document is required to do so within the time limits and in the manner provided for in Art. 16.2, Art. 17.5, Art. 17.11 and Art. 18.4, depending on the applicable Sales Model and on the issuer. The Seller, Fleequid and the Buyer are required to provide promptly the cooperation necessary for the correct issue, correction or reissue of the tax and administrative documents resulting from the Cancellation of the Sale, from the reduction of its subject matter or from the return of the sums. The obligation to return the sums is neither suspended nor deferred by any delay in the issue, transmission or correction of the tax documents by the person required to do so, unless performance of the obligation to return is objectively prevented by mandatory provisions of law.
translations.u221: Sums which, notwithstanding the Cancellation of the Sale, the reduction of its subject matter or the arising of an obligation to return, remain definitively due pursuant to these General Terms and Conditions are not subject to return. Such sums include, in particular, the Commissions already accrued pursuant to Art. 12.4, without prejudice to the provisions of Art. 14.7 concerning the Commissions payable by the Buyer in the event of a Cancellation not attributable to the Buyer; the Fees relating to Services already rendered; the expenses and costs already incurred by Fleequid in relation to the transaction; the penalties, default interest and reimbursements of expenses contractually due; the Advance Payment which, pursuant to Art. 13.6, has been converted into a penalty following the Cancellation of the Sale on account of delay in payment or failure to pay attributable to the Buyer pursuant to Art. 13.5. This provision also applies in the case of Cancellation of the Sale ordered by Fleequid as the outcome of the handling of a complaint pursuant to Art. 20.8: in such case the Commissions already accrued, the Fees relating to Services already rendered and the expenses and costs already incurred by Fleequid are not refunded under any circumstances, either to the Seller or to the Buyer. The aforesaid sums may be retained or set off, within the limits permitted by law, by the person to whom they are owed against the sums that the same person is required to return; any excess remaining after such set-off is returned within the time limits and in the manner provided for in this article. The separate rules on the Security Deposit referred to in Art. 6.3 remain unaffected.
translations.u222: Where the Cancellation of the Sale, the termination of the Contract or any other case provided for in these General Terms and Conditions entails, in whole or in part, the reinstatement of the previous situation after the transfer of ownership of the Vehicle, its delivery or the payment of sums has already taken place, the Parties are required to carry out without delay all activities and provide all cooperation necessary for the reinstatement, including the return of the sums received, the return or redelivery of the Vehicle, the signing and delivery of the necessary documents, the completion of the administrative formalities and the retransfer or re-registration of ownership. Where the legal basis on which the Seller received sums relating to the Vehicle ceases to exist, in whole or in part, the Seller is required to return in full what it received, within the limits corresponding to the restitutionary effects of the specific case. In particular: a) in the Commission Sale performed by means of Resale, the Seller returns to Fleequid any sums already paid to it by Fleequid in relation to the Vehicle being returned; b) where Fleequid has acted as a Pure Intermediary, the Seller returns directly to the Buyer the price and the further sums received by it and, where Fleequid has advanced to the Buyer, in whole or in part, the sums owed by the Seller, the Seller is required to reimburse them to Fleequid; c) in Dealer Sales, where the Cancellation or the termination also entails the lapse, in whole or in part, of the effects of the purchase concluded between the Seller and Fleequid, the Seller returns to Fleequid the Purchase Price already received and the further amounts that must be returned. The returns of sums provided for in this paragraph must be made within the time limit laid down in Art. 15.2 and each person so required is also obliged to issue and transmit, within the time limits provided for in Art. 15.5, the credit notes, the reversal or correction documents and any further tax documents that may be necessary; delay in the issue or transmission of such documents neither suspends nor defers the obligation to return the sums, save as mandatorily provided for by law. Where the specific case entails the return of the Vehicle to the Seller, the Seller is required to reacquire or otherwise regain ownership of it, where already transferred, to take possession of it and to provide promptly all cooperation necessary for the relevant formalities; these rules apply, in particular, in the Commission Sale, both where Fleequid has operated by means of Resale and where it has acted as a Pure Intermediary, in so far as compatible with the structure of the specific transaction. In Dealer Sales, where the Cancellation concerns exclusively the sale between Fleequid and the Buyer, the Vehicle is returned to Fleequid; where the Cancellation or the termination also entails the lapse, in whole or in part, of the effects of the purchase relationship between the Seller and Fleequid, the Seller is required to regain ownership and possession of the Vehicle and to carry out all the steps necessary for that purpose. The Seller or the Buyer, where required to return sums, to return or redeliver the Vehicle, to retransfer or re-register ownership, to collect the Vehicle, to return the relevant documents or to complete the necessary formalities, may not unjustifiably refuse or delay performance. Without prejudice to the time limit provided for in Art. 15.2 for the return of the sums, the obligations relating to the return or redelivery of the Vehicle, to the retransfer or re-registration, to collection and to the relevant documentation must be performed within 5 (five) days from Fleequid's written request, unless the nature of the obligation or mandatory provisions of law require a different time limit. Once the applicable time limit has expired without performance for reasons attributable to it, the defaulting Seller or Buyer is required to pay Fleequid, by way of penalty, the amount of €150.00 (EUR one hundred and fifty/00) for each day of delay and for each Vehicle concerned, up to a maximum aggregate amount of €5,000.00 (EUR five thousand/00) for each Vehicle, without prejudice to compensation for any further damage. Where, with reference to the same Vehicle, several obligations to return provided for in this paragraph and incumbent on the same person are simultaneously unperformed, the said daily penalty applies only once for each day of delay and for each Vehicle, without prejudice to the further penalties provided for in these General Terms and Conditions for distinct facts or breaches. Without prejudice to the said penalty, in the event of failure to perform in good time Fleequid may take, directly or through third parties and within the limits permitted by law, the measures reasonably necessary for the custody, storage, transport, preservation, recovery or management of the Vehicle, charging the relevant costs and expenses in full to the defaulting person. From the expiry of the time limit for performance, the defaulting person also bears, within the limits permitted by law, the risks and burdens arising from its own delay and may not rely on the failure to return the sums, the failure to collect or redeliver the Vehicle, the failure to sign the documents or its own failure to cooperate in order to suspend or delay the restitutionary effects. The final allocation of the expenses relating to the transfer or retransfer of ownership, to re-registration, to transport, to redelivery, to custody and to storage of the Vehicle is governed by the provision applicable to the cause of the Cancellation or of the termination. In the absence of a specific provision, such expenses are borne by the person to whom the cause of the Cancellation or of the termination is attributable, to the extent that they are a consequence thereof; where the relevant cause is not attributable to any of the Parties, the allocation is made in accordance with the rules applicable to the specific case and the provisions of law.
translations.u223: The Commissions, the Fees, the Security Deposit, the reimbursements of costs and expenses, the penalties, the interest and compensation for damage retain their independent and distinct nature and are each governed by their own rules. The penalties provided for in these General Terms and Conditions in relation to independent and distinct breaches may be cumulated with one another. Several penalties referable to the same underlying fact and intended to protect the same interest are not cumulated, unless expressly provided otherwise. Where the same underlying fact is expressly governed by a provision which lays down a specific penalty for that breach, only that penalty applies, and it prevails over the penalties laid down by provisions of more general scope which include the same fact among their conditions. The rights of Cancellation of the Sale, of termination and of suspension, as well as the obligations of indemnity and of reimbursement and the right to compensation for any further damage provided for in the concurrent provisions, remain unaffected in any event. The special provisions which expressly regulate the cumulation, the non-cumulation or the supplementing of certain financial consequences prevail over the general rule laid down in this paragraph. For all the penalties provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, Fleequid's right to compensation for any further damage remains unaffected in any event, solely for the part exceeding what has already been satisfied by way of penalty. The amounts paid by way of penalty and the sums applied pursuant to Art. 6.3 are counted only once and do not give rise to duplication of the same item.

Allineato alla resa della definizione all'art. 18.7 (blocco k08, u258: "purchase for stock").
Come nella definizione di Advance Payment (k01, u035).

new_terms.why: Resa standard; 'make available' già nella v8 EN.
Allineato al blocco k08 (u240); 'material fact' in inglese giuridico significa 'fatto rilevante'.

notes: Elenchi a), b), c): mantenuta la forma dell'IT v9 'a)' (come 'letter d)' nei rinvii fissati in k01); la v8 EN usava '(a)'. Da uniformare con gli altri blocchi.
Importi: '€150.00' e '€5,000.00 (five thousand/00 euros)' secondo la convenzione della v8 EN.
u200 lett. e): 'guasto' (minuscolo, generico) reso 'failure' per coerenza con il glossario (Guasto = Failure).
u201: 'opera unitariamente' reso 'operates as a single cap' (il massimale è unico per Veicolo e operazione, per entrambi i ritardi).
u202/u221: 'ritardo o mancato pagamento ... imputabile all'Acquirente' reso riferendo 'attributable to the Buyer' al ritardo/mancato pagamento.

u207: 'annullamento del contratto per cause di invalidità' reso 'annulment of the contract on grounds of invalidity' per distinguerlo da 'Cancellation'; 'Annullamento' (forma breve maiuscola) = 'Cancellation', 'annullamento' minuscolo dei Veicoli = 'cancellation'.
u211, u222, u223: 'presente comma' reso 'this paragraph'.
u213: 'consegue il proprio buon fine ai sensi dell'art. 12.4' reso 'is successfully completed'; da allineare con la resa di 'buon fine' nell'art. 12.4 (blocco k05).
review: u200: 'or from failing to comply with the other conditions laid down' → 'or from the other conditions laid down' — l'IT dice 'derivanti dal superamento dei limiti … o dalle altre condizioni': tolta l'aggiunta interpretativa.
u201: 'maximum aggregate amount' → 'maximum total amount' — stessa resa di 'importo massimo complessivo' usata nell'art. 12.6 (k05 u190/u191), cui la clausola rinvia.

u202: 'delay in paying or failure to pay the Advance Payment or the balance attributable to the Buyer' → 'delay in paying, or failure to pay, the Advance Payment or the balance, in each case attributable to the Buyer' — eliminata l'ambiguità ('balance attributable to the Buyer'): imputabile è il ritardo/mancato pagamento.
u202: 'ceases to be applicable to the price' → 'can no longer be applied to the price' — 'applicable to' si legge come 'si applica a'; il senso è 'cessa di essere imputabile al prezzo'.
u208: 'in the event of reasons attributable to the Seller in transactions' → ', for reasons attributable to the Seller, in transactions' — inglese non idiomatico; senso invariato.
u209, u216, u221: 'effected' → 'ordered' — 'Annullamento disposto' è reso 'ordered' negli altri blocchi (k03 u113, k05 u191, k07 u231, k09 u298).
u211: 'stock purchase' → 'purchase for stock' — resa della locuzione definita all'art. 18.7 (k08 u258).
u222: 'maximum aggregate amount' → 'maximum total amount' — come u201 e k05 u190.
u223: 'same material fact' (2 volte) → 'same underlying fact' — 'material fact' è un falso amico (= fatto rilevante); allineato a k08 u240.
